Class for accessing and managing files in an S3 bucket using hashed organization IDs.

# Purpose
The code defines a class `S3BucketAccess` that provides functionality for interacting with an Amazon S3 bucket. It is designed to manage files within a bucket that is uniquely identified by a hashed organization ID. The class uses the `boto3` library to create an S3 client, which is configured with AWS credentials and settings imported from `app.core.config`. The primary operations supported by this class include uploading files, retrieving file content, and deleting files from the S3 bucket.

The `S3BucketAccess` class includes methods for hashing the organization ID to create a bucket name, constructing file paths within the bucket, and performing file operations. The [`upload_file`](<#s3bucketaccessupload_file>) method uploads a file to a specified path in the bucket, while the [`get_file_content`](<#s3bucketaccessget_file_content>) method retrieves the content of a file, handling both text and binary files. The [`delete_file`](<#s3bucketaccessdelete_file>) method removes a file from the bucket and logs the deletion. This class is intended to be used as part of a larger application, providing a structured interface for S3 bucket interactions.
